player_prompt.intro:
Ame wò {player_id} le Connect Four me.
Amea dzeside: {symbol}.
Agbadzamɔdzi la kɔ ɖeka {num_rows} kple {num_cols} ƒe akpa.
Ameawo ɖo tɔtrɔ gbɔ kpɔkpɔ ƒe akpa (0 yi {end_col}).
Ame si kpɔ dzesi wu (ede dzesi) ene la, edzi.
Le wo ɖo me, dze akpa ƒe xexlẽ ɖe akpe gbɔnɔ me.
Gbɔnɔtɔ: '[col 4]' alo '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Fefeƒekplɔ̃a megale dzedzem na fefewɔlawo o.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ame {player_id}, ɖo si me ɖe o. Ɖo si wu: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ame {player_id}, ɖo si me ɖe o. Akpa {col} la me kpɔa o.
invalid_move.already_full: Ame {player_id}, ɖo si me ɖe o. Akpa {col} la kpɔ.

action.dropped_disk: Dagbe {player_id} wɔ dɔkɛ ({player_symbol}) si na kɔlɔm {col}.

outcome.win: Ame {player_id} dzia ne ene dzesi ene!
outcome.draw: Woƒo bɔl la wòyi edzi ʋuu.
